primary.description: Charcoal — deep professionalism; primary text, borders, and interactive states.

secondary.description: Moss Green — organic growth; CTAs, success states, and brand highlights.

accent.description: Blue Bell — digital precision; links, active focus rings, and data indicators.

tertiary.description: Tangerine — alerts and urgency ONLY. Never use decoratively.

surface.description: Mint Cream — primary page background and card surfaces.

success.description: Affirmative states: attendance confirmed, grade submitted, payment received.

error.description: Destructive states: failed validation, system error, access denied.

blush.description: Hover and fill backgrounds — a softer tint of the surface for interactive feedback.

ink.description: Absolute darkest tone — full-bleed landing page hero backgrounds only.

deep.description: Deep background layer — secondary hero sections and cinematic overlays.

surface.description: Dark surface — card backgrounds within dark-themed landing sections.

surface2.description: Elevated dark surface — raised cards and modals in the cinematic context.

bone.description: Brightest neutral — primary text and icons on all dark cinematic backgrounds.

cream.description: Warm off-white — secondary text and subtle decorative elements on dark backgrounds.

haze.description: Cool off-white — dividers and subtle borders within the cinematic palette.

moss.description: Brand secondary adapted for dark contexts — matches brand.secondary on light.

mossGlow.description: Illuminated moss — hover state and active glow on dark backgrounds only.

mossDeep.description: Deep moss — pressed/active state for moss-colored interactive elements.

tang.description: Brand tertiary adapted for dark contexts — alerts and urgency on dark surfaces only.

tangGlow.description: Illuminated tang — hover/focus glow for tang-colored elements on dark backgrounds.

blue.description: Accent adapted for dark contexts — data indicators and links on dark backgrounds.

dim.description: Muted neutral — secondary or disabled text within the cinematic palette.

dim2.description: Light muted neutral — tertiary labels and metadata in the cinematic context.

foreground.description: Default text color — maps to brand.primary.

background.description: Default page background — maps to brand.surface.

border.description: Subtle divider and container border — brand.primary at 12.5% opacity.

display.description: Headings and expressive brand moments — pair with fontWeight.light or fontWeight.regular for elegance.

sans.description: All body copy, UI labels, and data — the default font for 95% of the interface.

serif.description: Fallback serif stack only — never set directly; use fontFamily.display.

xs.description: Step -2 — micro labels, badge text, timestamps. Ratio: 1.25×.

sm.description: Step -1 — small UI labels and captions. Ratio: 1.13×.

base.description: Step 0 — body text and default UI size. WCAG 1.4.4 base.

h4.description: Step 1 — subheadings and card titles. Base × 1.25¹.

h1.description: Step 4 — dashboard apex heading. Base × 1.25⁴. Use global.h1 for hero contexts without a container.
Root-level h1 — landing page section headers without a container context. Uses svw for address-bar-safe scaling.

display.description: Hero display text — Step 5. Landing page only; no container context. Base × 1.25⁵. Ratio: 1.25×.

light.description: Display headings in Fraunces — editorial elegance.

regular.description: Body copy and default prose in Plus Jakarta Sans.

medium.description: UI labels, navigation items, and subtle emphasis.

bold.description: Strong emphasis, KPI figures, and dashboard metrics.

black.description: Maximum weight — apex data callouts only. Use sparingly.

tight.description: Large display headings to correct optical looseness.

normal.description: Default — body copy and standard UI text.

wider.description: Section eyebrow labels and category tags.

widest.description: All-caps micro labels and institutional headings.

none.description: Display and hero text where optical tightness is intentional.

1.description: 4px equiv — micro gaps and icon padding.

8.description: 32px equiv — card padding and section gaps.

24.description: 96px equiv — hero section vertical breathing room.

none.description: Sharp corners — table cells and strict data grids.

sm.description: 2px equiv — very subtle rounding for inline elements.

base.description: 6px equiv — standard input fields and small buttons.

xl.description: 12px equiv — Tailwind xl mapping for larger interactive elements.

card.description: 40px equiv — signature Wajina card corner. Primary brand shape.

full.description: Effectively infinite — pills, avatars, and circular elements.

soft.description: Lightest elevation — subtle depth for inline elements and hover states.

card.description: Standard card elevation — default depth for all dashboard card surfaces.

prestige.description: Premium double-layer shadow — modals, drawers, and elevated overlays.

premium.description: Highest elevation — hero feature cards and command palette surfaces.

brand.description: Wajina brand spring — GPU-composited. Default for all Motion variants.

easeOut.description: Standard deceleration — elements entering the viewport or expanding.

easeIn.description: Standard acceleration — elements leaving the viewport or collapsing.

easeInOut.description: Symmetrical — state toggles where enter and exit share equal weight.

instant.description: Immediate feedback — focus rings, checkbox ticks.

base.description: Standard transition — default for all Motion variants.

slow.description: Page-level transitions and complex layout shifts.

cinematic.description: Hero and scrollytelling sequences — landing page only.
